To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a novel aptameric BLi assay was established for detection of recombinant human EPO-α, which exhibited a good linear response range, high sensitivity, and low LOD, as well as the feasibility in real complex matrix.
a novel aptameric biosensor was established for real-time, label-free, and sensitive detection of recombinant human EPO-α.

the BLI system based on the 3'-biotinylated 39nt ssDNA aptamer was established for label-free and high-sensitive detection of EPO, and the signal amplification strategy via sandwiched format with wheat germ agglutin was developed to improve the detection sensitivity.

the application of BLI technique for the detection of protein EPO- α, and the results showed that this technique is a promising tool for the detection of other proteins and other biomolecules.
the development of aptamer-based BLI assays for the detection of EPO.
a new biosensing technique for the detection of protein EPO- α, which has great potential for practical application in the fields of clinical diagnosis, food safety and environmental monitoring.

the biolayer interferometric assay is a new surface-sensing technique for real time, high sensitive detection of analytes.
the BLI assay for detection of ERO-α based on aptamer 39 was established and the signal amplification strategy was developed to improve the sensitivity of this assay.
the BLI assay based on aptamers has the potential to be used in the field of protein detection.

a novel BLI sensing system for protein interaction and detection was developed, and the BLI sensing system provided an efficient and convenient approach to detect the target protein in the complex matrix such human plasma.

the BLI system was successfully established to detect protein with the high affinity and specificity of ssDNA aptamers, and the signal amplification approach was established for the detection of EPO in complex biological matrix.
